_about: Robert Drew Hicks (1850-1929), Cambridge classicist, editor of Aristotle's De Anima. Raw IA OCR: Stoic and Epicurean, Epochs of Philosophy series (New York: Scribner, 1910). His Loeb Diogenes Laertius (1925) is Greek facing and held back like the other Greek-facing Loebs. Not Elias Hicks (shelf elias-hicks). US public domain. No uids minted. Also raw IA: The Politics of Aristotle, Books I-V, a revised text with introduction, analysis and commentary, with Franz Susemihl (Macmillan, 1894).

r-d-hicks-susemihl-politics-1894: The Politics of Aristotle, a revised text, with introduction, analysis and commentary, Books I-V, by Franz Susemihl and R. D. Hicks (London and New York: Macmillan, 1894); Greek text with English commentary, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling
